content.text: The connection job is queued, so I'll check its status.

Yes, verification finished successfully. Your Google account is connected using the existing ghealth CLI credentials, and a read-only API check (`users.getIdentity`) worked.

- **Permissions granted:** activity and fitness, ECG, health metrics and measurements, IRN, location, logged symptoms, mindfulness, nutrition, profile, reproductive health, settings, and sleep. Nothing was denied.
- **Token status:** active.

Limitations to be aware of:
- Google's consent screen is in Testing mode, so refresh tokens expire after 7 days. When that happens, run `ghealth auth login` and the server will pick up the new credentials.
- Google isn't onboarding new projects, so this connection depends on the shared ghealth setup used by health-coach-app.

I haven't imported any data yet. If you want your history pulled into the local database, I can start an import next.
